page.layout: Printed page 313 with a running head at the top, and one column of running text. A marginal note stands in the right margin beside the line "Collocatio deinde in". The gathering signature is at the foot right.

main_text.l: sentiæ ex cōtrariis locis ducētur: ita qui-
dem vt ioci ac facetiæ vituperētur, in qui-
bus nihil, vel ambiguitate, vel verbi inter-
pretatione, vel allegoria, vel aliis elegans
ac venustum: nihil etiam aptum & deco-
rum deprehēditur. Collocatio deinde in
his ita instituetur: vt prima pars exordiū
breuem acceptarum literarum [?]
repetitionem habeat: altera narratio ali-
arum facetiarum, vel laudé atq; approba-
tionem, vel reprehensione & vituperatio-
nem cōtineat: tertia & postrema conclu-
sio petitione, vel adhortatione aliqua se-
ria absoluatur. Vtriusque generis, & eius,
quo aliorū in scribēdo vrbanitate lauda-
mus, & quo reprehendimus atq; impro-
bamus, exemplū est egregiū lib.7.epist.32.
in qua ad volumniū Cicero scribit: & qui-
dem primò eius festiuitate ac vrbanitate
laudat. Deinde, quia illius nomine dicta
quaedam circumferebantur infulfa & in-
epta, quibus quasi notis à suis illa debeat
distingui, ostendit, partes illius tres sunt.
Exordium ab occasione scribendarum li-
terarū sumptum. Narratio, in qua facetiae
partim laudantur, partim vituperantur.
Conclusio [illegible, ~5 letters] adhortatione facta: vt
crebro scribat Volumnius, & Dolabellam

page.notes: The Greek word after "literarum" is printed as roughly ἐπαναλήψιν and is marked [?]; the Greek word after "Conclusio" is too faint to read and is marked illegible. The word "sponsionum" in the margin is uncertain and set as sponsionum. The margin note reads "cofas." as printed. The signature is "u 5". Some words are broken across lines without a printed hyphen (for example "vituperatio / nem") and are written whole. The scan is a little skewed and the right edge is shadowed, but the text is legible.
